summary: Tested Our Tasks module - team-wide task management feature. Fixed critical bug where timer functionality was broken due to mismatch between backend (is_running boolean) and frontend (status string). All features now working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up test tasks during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Our Tasks module fully tested. Features verified: 1) Page loads with title 'Our Tasks' and subtitle 'Team-wide task management for all users' 2) Stats cards showing Total Tasks, Pending, In Progress, Completed 3) Filter tabs (All, My Tasks, Pending, In Progress, Completed) working 4) Advanced filters (Date, Assigned To, Assigned By, Type, Status) working 5) Task CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) working 6) Timer functionality (Start, Pause, Resume, Finish) working correctly 7) Task detail modal showing all information including time tracking sessions 8) Our Tasks nav link visible in sidebar. Bug fixed: time_tracking field was using 'is_running' boolean but frontend expected 'status' string - changed backend to use 'status' field with values 'not_started', 'running', 'paused', 'finished'. Also fixed frontend API endpoint from '/time-tracking' to '/time'.

page_load.details: Page loads with correct title 'Our Tasks' and subtitle 'Team-wide task management for all users'

stats_cards.details: Stats cards showing Total Tasks, Pending, In Progress, Completed with correct counts

filter_tabs.details: All filter tabs (All, My Tasks, Pending, In Progress, Completed) working correctly

advanced_filters.details: Date, Assigned To, Assigned By, Type, Status filters all present and functional

task_creation.details: Tasks can be created with name, description, priority, type, due date, recurrence, work link

task_update.details: Tasks can be edited - title, description, priority, type, status, etc.

task_delete.details: Tasks can be deleted with confirmation dialog

timer_start.details: Timer starts correctly, status changes to 'running', task status changes to 'in_progress'

timer_pause.details: Timer pauses correctly, status changes to 'paused', time is tracked

timer_resume.details: Timer resumes correctly, status changes back to 'running'

timer_finish.details: Timer finishes correctly, status changes to 'finished', task status changes to 'completed', Done badge shown

task_detail_modal.details: Task detail modal shows all information including description, created by, assigned to, due date, time tracking with sessions

sidebar_navigation.details: Our Tasks nav link visible in sidebar with data-testid='nav-our-tasks'

timer_status_field_mismatch.issue: Backend was using 'is_running' boolean field but frontend expected 'status' string field with values 'not_started', 'running', 'paused', 'finished'
timer_status_field_mismatch.fix: Changed time_tracking to use 'status' field instead of 'is_running' to match BDE Tasks implementation

timer_api_endpoint_mismatch.issue: Frontend was calling '/api/our-tasks/tasks/{taskId}/time-tracking' but backend route was '/api/our-tasks/tasks/{task_id}/time'
timer_api_endpoint_mismatch.fix: Changed frontend API call to use correct endpoint '/api/our-tasks/tasks/${taskId}/time'
